raw_text: The make_ingest bundle format was reworked so its header records exactly what is actually contained in the bundle rather than whatever git status happens to report, with both directions verified — a clean tracked file no longer falsely warns, and a modified tracked file that is genuinely in the bundle still triggers the warning. The bundle structure itself was specified as a single self-describing file with per-file entries carrying start_line, end_line, byte count, sha256, and description, relying on Drive's revision history for versioning instead of dated copies or a separate index file. Speculative chat-session ideas (a sparse JSON construct, field profiles, a parked-mechanism registry, an entanglement test) must be marked PROPOSED rather than measured, keeping honest provenance about what has been demonstrated versus merely imagined.
